_doc: Words a leaderboard name may not contain (racetraq/moderation.py). Matched case-insensitively after undoing common letter swaps (0->o, 1->i, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 7->t, @->a, $->s) as whole words with a plain ending (shits, fucker), or as the whole name spelled with dots or spaces (f.u.c.k). Whole words only, so real names such as Scunthorpe or Dickens stay allowed. A booth adds its own words with [leaderboard] blocklist in a config overlay. Kept short on purpose: it catches the obvious, an operator clears the rest from the board (#operator).
